## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:

Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->

This pull request makes a targeted fix to the precipitation source calculations in the `src/Common/tendency.jl` file. The change corrects which precipitation category is updated, ensuring that rain (`N_rai`) is incremented instead of liquid (`N_liq`).

Precipitation source calculation correction:

* Updated the accumulation of precipitation sources so that `aux.precip_sources.N_rai` is incremented by `S₁ + S₂` instead of `aux.precip_sources.N_liq`, ensuring the correct category is modified.
title: fix: rain number adjustment bug

## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->

This pull request updates the moisture source computation logic in `src/Common/tendency.jl` to improve the handling of liquid particle mass production in two-moment precipitation schemes. The main change is the introduction of a threshold to prevent mass production when there are insufficient liquid particles, which helps maintain physical consistency in the model.

**Precipitation scheme improvements:**

* Added a check in the `precompute_aux_moisture_sources!` function to ensure mass production of liquid particles (`S_q_liq`) only occurs when the ratio of liquid particles to aerosol particles exceeds a threshold in the `Precipitation2M` scheme. This prevents unphysical production when particle numbers are low.
title: feat(2M): limit vap->liq mass transfer for small N_liq
